definition: The mind become single and undivided, especially as thinking and pondering settle in the second mental theme.
notes: Governed as singleness so it stays distinct from samādhi, which is now unification of mind. The fixed formula phrase cetaso ekodibhāva is governed separately as singleness of mind; the adjectival ekodi in refrains such as MN 119's is single. Unification is discouraged here because it would collapse this term into the samādhi headword.
version_notes: Added 2026-11-08 to govern wording the samādhi ruling introduced into the translations.
